svg.aria-label: Schematic of JANUS: Gaia observes a red giant; its XP spectrum becomes 110 coefficients with parallax, photometry and extinction; eight normalising-flow networks trained on APOGEE DR19 return six labels with a spread and a miss probability; the test on withheld stars gives the scatter about APOGEE; the same network without the spectrum merges the two alpha sequences; the catalogue covers 144,304 TESS red giants; the networks run on Deucalion and MareNostrum 5.

g.text: one star as a row of numbers
the same network, with and without the spectrum
one row in ten has APOGEE values too
Deucalion, Gaia DR3, about 220 million spectra · MareNostrum 5, Gaia DR4, about 1.8 billion
